scope: Post-formation audit of four already public prospective comparisons. Formation, selection, raw results and holdouts are frozen. Neither new candidate discovery nor external novelty is tested.
inventoryReason: This pre-comparison repository revision contains the completed historical #383 adapters for all four forms and the project known-rule catalogue. Use their complete historical run output over the original frozen corpus. This is a finite named project catalogue, not a search across every project rule, commit or literature reference. Historical reference fits may include held-out cases; they are available only in this retrospective audit.

matching.recurrence: Match the normalized ordered vector of exact rational homogeneous recurrence coefficients, keeping different orders separate even if a finite prefix admits both equations. Keep native model identities and source rows of matches. No extrapolation to mathematical novelty.
matching.finiteDifferences: Match the complete ordered initial forward-difference vector in the common Newton basis at n=0. Keep the degree and intercept. Missing recoverable native coefficients produce explicit incomparability.
matching.macros: Use the historical full macro adapter output and the native RulePatternCanonicalizer alpha-normalized directed pattern identity. Compare ordered abstract operation sequence and assumptions separately. Retain the existing native KnownRuleRepository.statusFor and symbolic validation from the frozen output as different fields.
matching.rational: Compare selected program operation membership with the native pre-comparison RationalNormalizationHypothesisOperator and historical frozen program. A selected subset gets subset status, not exact historical program identity. Preserve guarded identity witnesses and primitive scope.
matching.residual: Absence from any named finite inventory means no exact match in that specific inventory only. Preserve unsupported and incomparable representations. Never infer NEW from missing coverage.

accounting: Retain all twelve campaign-arm slots per form, including zero outputs. Report realized accepted candidates, genuinely distinct semantic keys, project-match witnesses, formation support, observed refutations/rejections, proof scope and held-out outcomes in their native units. Distinguish paired macro utility from checks of candidate reuse or reachability. No aggregate capability score.
